The receipt of boycott requests and boycott agreements made. Current revision Form 5713 PDF Instructions for Form 5713 ( Print Version PDF ) Recent developments None at this time. Schedules Schedule A (Form 5713) International Boycott Factor (Section 999(c)(1)) Complete Schedule A (Form 5713) if: You participated in or cooperated with an international boycott. You are using the international boycott factor to figure the loss of tax benefits. Schedule A (Form 5713) PDF Schedule B (Form 5713) Specifically Attributable Taxes and Income (Section 999(c)(2)) Complete Schedule B (Form 5713) if: You participated in or cooperated with an international boycott, and You figure the loss of tax benefits by specifically attributing taxes and income. Schedule B (Form 5713) PDF Schedule C (Form 5713), Tax Effect of the International Boycott Provisions Use Schedule C (Form 5713) to compute the loss of tax benefits attributable to participation in or cooperation with an international boycott.
